Name: Pig To Bear Sound
Author: o0MrPro
Description:
[color=#ffe599]This version only requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher﻿. 
[/color]
This mod was made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2707?tab=description](CP) Friendly Magical Vegan Truffle Bears[/url] since someone mentioned it in my comments and for bear lovers out there!

[size=3]Requirements:[/size]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]
[/url][size=3]﻿Installing:[/size]
- Put the unzipped folder "[CP] PigToBearSound" into your mods folder.
- Run the game [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]using SMAPI
[/url]- enjoy!

Manifest.Name: PigToBearSound
Manifest.Description: Adds sounds for Truffle Bears by replacing the default pig sound.
Manifest.Author: o0MrPro
